List, inspect, and drop a scenario's runs

Source: R/save-scenario.R
scenario_runs.Rd

A solved scenario's runs live under <scenario>/runs/ — base-problem runs directly (runs/glpk/), own-problem variants as named folders holding their solves (runs/cal-d24/glpk/) — each with a run.yml provenance record (see solve_scenario()). The scenario manifest's default: field names the default run.

  • scenario_runs() lists them as a tibble — one row per run, including legacy script/<solver>/ directories from older layouts (status = "legacy").

  • scenario_run_info() returns one run's full run.yml record as a list.

  • drop_scenario_run() deletes a run directory. The active run (the one currently loaded in the scenario object) is refused unless force = TRUE.

Usage

scenario_runs(object)

scenario_run_info(object, run)

drop_scenario_run(object, run, force = FALSE)

Arguments

object

a scenario object with a non-empty @path.

run

character, run identifier: "<solve>" for a base-problem run or "<variant>/<solve>".

force

logical, allow dropping the active run.

Value

scenario_runs() a tibble (run, variant, solve, status, solver_name, lang, started, duration_sec, peak_mb, updated, objective, modinp, active); scenario_run_info() a named list; drop_scenario_run() the dropped directory, invisibly.

Examples

# \donttest{
ek   <- topia$modules$electricity$R3
mod  <- newModel("TOPIA", data = ek$repo,
                 calendar = topia$modules$calendars$s4_h24,
                 region = ek$regions,
                 horizon = topia$modules$horizons$base,
                 discount = 0.05)
mod <- setGeoscale(mod, ek$geoscale)
scen <- interpolate_model(mod, name = "EX")
#> Cost declared at a coarse geoscale level:
#>   TBD_COA_WEST_CENTRAL@invcost: CENTRAL, WEST
#>   TBD_GAS_WEST_CENTRAL@invcost: CENTRAL, WEST
#> The cost is charged ONCE at that cell rather than at each child region, and is discounted at the children's rate. That is usually what a national cost datum means -- said here because it is a different number from naming the children individually.

# a freshly interpolated scenario has no runs yet; each solve adds one
scenario_runs(scen)
#> # A tibble: 0 × 13
#> # ℹ 13 variables: run <chr>, variant <chr>, solve <chr>, status <chr>,
#> #   solver_name <chr>, lang <chr>, started <chr>, duration_sec <dbl>,
#> #   peak_mb <dbl>, updated <chr>, objective <dbl>, modinp <chr>, active <lgl>
# }
